# Innovative Tech Solutions

Innovative Tech Solutions is a single-page business website for web development, programming lessons, and IT consulting.

## Canonical site

- https://www.innovativetechsolution.tech/

## What the site offers

- Website and web app development
- Private programming lessons
- Consulting, maintenance, and training
- A contact form that opens email to wangamalinda4@gmail.com
